text:
mara-peopleops: Heads up team, new hire Ryan starts Mon 05/04 hybrid (Seattle). Two blockers: BG vendor flagged SSN_MISMATCH and passport is expiring in 6 months which may affect office badge printing. Need options for I-9 and BG docs and whether we can delay badge until new passport.
dan-it: For device and badge access we can issue temporary badge for week 1 if compliance ok. Laptop shipping needs correct legal name and SSN verification completed.
sam-recruiter: Ryan updated offer with his full legal name 'Ryan O. Kim'. He uploaded a scanned SSN card and passport copy to the secure HR portal this morning.
jess-compliance: Vendor note: case VND-112233 STATUS=SSN_MISMATCH. Vendor needs either SSN card image and one additional supporting doc (paystub or W-2) showing same SSN and name history. Passport expiry under 1 year is okay for I-9 but some badge printers require valid ID; we can use driver's license if current.
ryan-newhire: Hi all, I posted a photo of my SSN card and last paystub to the portal. My passport renewal is in progress (applied last week), ETA 6-8 weeks. I can use my WA driver's license for badge and I-9 if that helps.
bg-check-bot: Vendor update: docs received for VND-112233. Re-run queued. ETA 48 hours.
jess-compliance: If vendor clears, compliance will attach verification note and mark 'I-9 verified remote' in Workday. For remote I-9, because Ryan is hybrid and can come onsite day 1, we can do a physical I-9 in-person at Seattle office to finalize. That avoids designated verifier complexity.
mara-peopleops: Plan: 1) wait for vendor re-run (48h), 2) Ryan brings original documents to Seattle office on day 1 for in-person I-9 completion, 3) IT issues temporary badge and laptop on site if verification pending, 4) benefits orientation scheduled Tue 05/05 10am PT. Everyone ok?
dan-it: Sounds good. I'll prepare laptop and temporary badge kit. Marking 'hold for in-person pick up' in ticket.
sam-recruiter: I'll confirm Ryan's day-1 arrival time and add a calendar invite for 10am benefits.
ryan-newhire: Thanks team! I'll bring originals (SSN card, WA license, passport renewal receipt) to office on day 1. Appreciate the temporary badge option.
bg-check-bot: Vendor finished re-run: STATUS=CLEAR. Case VND-112233 closed.
jess-compliance: Verified. I'll update Workday and notify IT to release final shipping if needed. Mara please convert tentative invites to confirmed.
mara-peopleops: Will do. Closing loop once Workday note is in. Thanks everyone! :tada:
